title: This Vulture Lives on Bones and Drops Them From 150 Meters
subject: bearded vulture

scenes.text: This bird's favorite meal is a skeleton. And it has a trick to get at it.
It's the bearded vulture, or lammergeier. Up to ninety percent of its diet is bone.
Bones too big to swallow? It carries them up and drops them onto rocks from a hundred meters or more.
It can lift bones weighing about half its own body weight.
Then the stomach finishes the job. Its acid is below pH one, and bone dissolves in hours.
A bird that turns a skeleton into lunch, one drop at a time.

description:
The bearded vulture eats bones for a living: up to 90 percent of its diet is bone.
It carries big bones high into the air and drops them from roughly 100 to 150 meters onto rocks to smash them, then swallows the pieces. Its stomach acid is below pH 1, strong enough to dissolve bone in a matter of hours.
Would you eat this diet for a day? Comment below.
first_comment: Sources differ on how long this trick takes to master and how high the drop is, but every one agrees the diet is mostly bone. Which animal has the strangest diet you know?
